column2: Title: Verify that full restaurant menu is displayed structured by categories when Guest joins session
column3: Status: Passed

column2:
Pre-conditions:
1. Guest has successfully joined the group session via shared invite link (US_G10).
2. Parent reservation status is "Reserved".
3. Restaurant menu contains dishes in categories: Appetizers, Main Courses, Desserts.

Steps:
1. Open the shared invite link.
2. Observe the Menu page layout, hero section, and category navigation bar.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Guest is on the Menu page.
2. Header and hero banner "Green and Tasty Restaurants / Menu" are displayed.
3. Category bar contains all available categories (Appetizers, Main Courses, Desserts).
4. Dishes are logically grouped and displayed according to the active category.

column2: Title: Verify menu item card details display (Name, Price, Serving Size, Authentic Image, Availability status)
column3: Status: Failed

column2:
Pre-conditions:
1. Guest is on the Menu page.
2. Available and unavailable dishes exist in the restaurant menu catalog.

Steps:
1. Examine available dish cards (e.g. Margherita Pizza).
2. Examine unavailable dish cards (e.g. Fresh Avocado Toast, Truffle Mushroom Risotto).
3. Compare photos with dish titles.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Each card displays:
- Dish title
- Price formatted with currency ($XX.XX)
- Serving size with weight in grams (e.g. "430 g")
- Authentic image corresponding to the dish (pizza for pizza, risotto for risotto)
- Clear availability indicator.
2. Unavailable dishes show "Sold Out" / "On Stop" badge.

column2: Title: Verify adding an available dish directly to personal subcart and updating cart counter badge
column3: Status: Failed

column2:
Pre-conditions:
1. Guest is on the Menu page.
2. Dish is in "Available" state.
3. Personal subcart is currently empty (0 items).

Steps:
1. Locate an available dish (e.g. Margherita Pizza).
2. Click the [Pre-order] button on the card.
3. Check the cart button and counter badge.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Dish is successfully added to the Guest's personal subcart without a full page refresh.
2. Action button provides visual feedback (e.g. state change or quantity control).
3. Cart icon displays a visible counter badge incremented to "1".

column2: Title: Verify that items marked "Sold Out" / "On Stop" cannot be selected or added to cart
column3: Status: Passed

column2:
Pre-conditions:
1. Guest is on the Menu page.
2. One or more dishes are marked as unavailable ("Sold Out" / "On Stop") in the catalog.

Steps:
1. Locate the unavailable dish card.
2. Check the card visual appearance (opacity/dimmed state).
3. Attempt to click on the card and the [Pre-Order] button.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Dish card has a visible "Sold Out" / "On Stop" badge.
2. Card has disabled/dimmed visual styling.
3. [Pre-Order] button is disabled (greyed out, unclickable) or hidden as in Figma.
4. Item cannot be added to the cart.

column2: Title: Verify viewing personal pre-order cart drawer, item removal, and quantity adjustment
column3: Status: Passed

column2:
Pre-conditions:
1. Guest has added 2 dishes to their personal subcart.
2. Guest is on the Menu page.

Steps:
1. Click on the cart button.
2. Observe the Cart drawer opened from the right.
3. Test quantity increment/decrement [-] [+] and trash icon [delete].
4. Observe Grand Total recalculation.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Cart drawer slides open titled "Cart" with subtitle "My Pre-Order".
2. Added items are listed with dish photo, title, prep time, quantity controls, and price.
3. Increasing/decreasing quantity updates item price and Grand Total immediately.
4. Clicking trash icon removes the dish from the subcart.
5. [Submit Pre-Order] button is enabled.
